title: Crash when uploading an empty CSV
body: Uploading a CSV with only a header row raises `IndexError: list index out of range` in `parse_rows` and the request returns 500. An empty file should just import zero rows.

title: Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page
body: Users have asked for a dark theme. Please add a toggle on the settings page that switches the UI theme and remembers the choice.

title: Bump requests from 2.28 to 2.32
body: requests 2.28 is affected by a published security advisory. Please upgrade to 2.32 in requirements.txt and make sure the test suite still passes.

title: Typo in CONTRIBUTING install command
body: CONTRIBUTING.md says `pip install -r requirement.txt` but the file is `requirements.txt`.

title: Make the HTTP request timeout configurable
body: The client timeout is hard-coded to 10 seconds in `client.py`. Slow partner APIs need longer. Please read it from an `API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` environment variable, defaulting to 10.

title: Page 2 of /orders repeats items from page 1
body: With `limit=10`, `GET /orders?page=2` returns three orders that were already on page 1. Looks like the offset calculation is off.

title: Search example in README returns 422
body: I copied the search example from the README: `curl /search?query=foo`. It returns 422. The API parameter is actually `q`, and `curl /search?q=foo` works fine. The README example is wrong.

title: Login broken after SQLAlchemy 2.0 upgrade
body: We upgraded to SQLAlchemy 2.0 last week and login now fails with `AttributeError: 'Session' object has no attribute 'query'` in a few places. Those call sites need migrating to the 2.0 `select()` style.

title: Export the monthly report as CSV
body: Finance wants to download the monthly report. Please add an export button that produces a CSV with the same columns as the on-screen table.

title: Enable mypy strict mode
body: Turn on `strict = true` for mypy in pyproject.toml and add the mypy check to the CI workflow.

title: Public helpers in utils.py have no docstrings
body: None of the public functions in `utils.py` have docstrings, so the generated API docs are empty for that module. Please document their parameters and return values.

title: Replace deprecated datetime.utcnow() calls
body: Python 3.12 warns that `datetime.utcnow()` is deprecated. We call it in five places. Please switch to `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`.

title: Unknown user id returns 500 instead of 404
body: `GET /users/99999` returns a 500 with a stack trace in the logs (`NoneType has no attribute email`). It should return 404 like the other endpoints.

title: Filter orders by date range
body: Please add optional `from` and `to` query parameters to `GET /orders` so we can list orders placed between two dates.

title: Log level is hard-coded to DEBUG
body: Production logs are huge because `logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG)` is hard-coded in `main.py`. Please read the level from a `LOG_LEVEL` environment variable, defaulting to INFO.

title: App got slow after the last release
body: Since 1.4.0 the dashboard takes 8 seconds to load instead of under 1. Nothing changed on our side.
